purpose: Make genuine prebound binding construction and after-Core policy validation distinguishable without forging typed objects.

constructor.performed_before_entry: Trusted pre-entry setup constructs this immutable data object. No first-clock/Core/entry or file admission is claimed by construction.
constructor.structural_capture: Each of current_output_ids,basis_ids,external_tcb_pins,prior_metadata_pins is an exact list of length<=256. Pin list entries are exact dicts with exactly id,bytes,sha256 keys; check cardinality then exactstr keys before keyset traversal. Other scalar positions and pin leaves accept only exact JSON scalar str/int/float/bool/None. ID list items likewise accept exact JSON scalars. No tuple/subclass/custom Mapping, nested containers in leaves, coercion, arbitrary protocols, encoding or caller callbacks. Detach list/pin containers into immutable tuple/data representations; immutable scalar objects may be referenced directly.
constructor.deferred: Do not validate scalar enums/ranges/string lengths/ASCII/digests/Unicode/pin semantics/duplicates/cross-role or mode relations here. Semantically invalid scalars remain representable immutable data for actual after-Core validation. Long strings are retained without copying/encoding; full domains and byte budgets are checked under the original clock. No physical/heap bound follows from caller-owned scalar storage.
constructor.constructor_refusal: KernelRefusal(POLICY_SCHEMA) for wrong containers/key shapes/custom leaves; KernelRefusal(POLICY_LIMIT) for constructor list length>256. These are CONSTRUCTOR_ONLY before entry, so no clock/Core count or entry policy failure may be claimed. Python argument-binding TypeError for missing/extra constructor arguments is also constructor-only.

core_validation: Exact namespace-bound binding object is retained after original Core creation; the full contract structural/domain/list-specific/output14/text/pin/binding/graph/canonical checks still run under that original clock. Invalidmode, ID129, outputcount15, duplicate/conflicting pins and cross-role/basis/current overlaps allowed by structural construction therefore genuinely reach CORE_POLICY_AFTER_ORIGINAL_START. Foreign kernel-class binding is checked on the actual supplied object, never an object.__setattr__ fixture forgery.
literals: All52 currently planned Native rows have structurally constructible bindings and expected_boundary=CORE_POLICY_AFTER_ORIGINAL_START. This is a prospective assertion, not evidence that a clock/Core was executed during metadata preparation. Constructor-only negatives are not added to this finite corpus; their structural refusal remains required contract behavior.
cleanup_compatibility: After a genuine eligible EXECUTION report, an unrelated later work/accounting error does not revoke previously known close rights. Do not add primary-is-None to the cleanup policy gate. A fresh CloseHandle remains subject to actual same-Core identity, reliable original hard-clock and once-right checks; stopped current calls never heal caches.
